Product Overview:
This lot includes a mixed assortment of rough minerals, gemstones, and tumbled stones. The collection features various natural stones such as quartz, rose quartz, pyrite, agate, amethyst, and possibly calcite. Included are several grayish-white cubic stones resembling marble or soapstone. The stones vary in color from pinks, greens, blues, and whites to metallic and earthy tones. Some pieces show natural crystal formations while others are more opaque or rough.

Specifications:
- Variety of natural stones including quartz, rose quartz, pyrite, agate, amethyst, and calcite
- Grayish-white cubic stones similar to marble or soapstone
- Mixed rough and tumbled stones with diverse shapes and colors
- Total weight approximately 7 lbs as shown in photos
